# Veycraft (`redasalem/veycraft`)

> Truthful CV tailoring for the AI agent you already use — local-first, Markdown-first AI career operations framework (53 skills) with a zero-dependency Node.js CLI (`dependencies: {}`, `devDependencies: {}`), fact-checked resume diffs, ATS keyword comparison, explicit True Gaps, and unconditional job-specific human `APPROVE` gates. Works across 25+ AI coding apps & CLIs with optional Playwright MCP and optional Notion MCP.

## Core Entrypoints

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical rules, progressive disclosure protocol, strict daily-run execution order, and 10 non-negotiable guardrails.
- [skills/REGISTRY.md](skills/REGISTRY.md): Consolidated 53-skill routing index (triggers, preconditions, verification contracts).
- [skills/skills-manifest.json](skills/skills-manifest.json): Machine-readable JSON catalog of all 53 consolidated skills.
- [docs/execution-safety.md](docs/execution-safety.md): Explicit separation of deterministic CLI enforcement (`bin/cli.mjs`) vs. agent workflow requirements (`AGENTS.md`, `skills/*.md`).
- [evals/README.md](evals/README.md) & [evals/RUBRIC.md](evals/RUBRIC.md): Deterministic CI schema & fixture validator (`npx github:redasalem/veycraft eval --baseline` or `--file <output.json>`).
- [evals/PROMPT.md](evals/PROMPT.md): Zero-shot reproducible evaluation prompt for external LLMs.
- [PLATFORMS.md](PLATFORMS.md): Global job board, B2B contract network, regional portal, and employer ATS compatibility matrix.
- [HIRED.md](HIRED.md): Authentic community outcomes ledger (strictly separated from maintainer origin).
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history (`v1.0.0` through `v1.4.1`).
- [README.md](README.md) & [README.ar.md](README.ar.md): English & RTL Arabic landing pages, CV tailoring preview, and installation guide.
- [docs/index.html](docs/index.html) & [docs/demo-dashboard.html](docs/demo-dashboard.html): Static primary CV Tailoring Demo and secondary Application Tracking Dashboard preview.
- [docs/SKILL_CATALOG.md](docs/SKILL_CATALOG.md), [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md), [docs/OPTIONAL_MCP_PLUGINS.md](docs/OPTIONAL_MCP_PLUGINS.md): Deep documentation.

## Playbooks & Modular Skills

- [Daily Run Orchestrator](skills/00-daily-run.md): Full `/daily-run` and `/apply-url` lifecycle orchestrator.
- [Readiness Gatekeeper](skills/00-interrogate-and-onboard.md): 5-gate profile audit and batched chat onboarding (`/setup`).
- [Resume Ingestion](skills/01-resume-ingestion.md): Pure-AI CV extraction and verification into structured JSON/Markdown.
- [Discover & Triage](skills/02-discover-and-triage.md): Ghost-job filter, 0-10 fit scoring, and Mission Control dashboard table.
- [Tailor Resume & Verify](skills/03-tailor-resume-and-verify.md): Anti-hallucination evidence mapping, anti-AI-slop humanizer, HTML-to-PDF rendering.
- [Fill & Apply](skills/04-fill-and-apply.md): Upload-first form filling, EEO/GDPR compliance defaults, and job-bound `APPROVE` safety gate.
- [Outreach & Interview Prep](skills/05-outreach-and-interview-prep.md): Interview dossier generation and draft-only `<= 75`-word outreach.
- [Log & Insights](skills/06-log-and-insights.md): Local JSON ledger (`logs/`), optional Notion MCP sync, and `/weekly-report`.
- [Persona Switcher](skills/07-persona-switcher.md): Multi-track career profiles under `context/personas/`.
- [Follow-Up Radar](skills/08-follow-up-radar.md): 7-day stale application detector and humanized check-in drafts.
- [Offer Negotiator](skills/09-offer-negotiator.md): Grounded B2B rate and salary counter-offer drafting (`DRAFT_ONLY`).
- [Autonomous Scheduler Loop](skills/10-autonomous-scheduler-loop.md): Safe recurring discovery within `active_hours` and warm-up caps.
- [Portfolio & GitHub Auditor](skills/11-portfolio-and-github-auditor.md): Pre-application audit of pinned repos, READMEs, and live URLs.
- [Recruiter Inbox Triage](skills/12-recruiter-inbox-triage.md): Classify recruiter replies, update local logs, and draft interview slot replies.
- [Company Due Diligence](skills/13-company-due-diligence.md): Domain authenticity check, layoff/churn signals, and `GREEN`/`YELLOW`/`RED` badges.
- [Privacy & PII Shield](skills/14-privacy-pii-shield.md): PII redaction guardrails for screenshots, demos, logs, and git safety.
- [Multilingual Adaptation](skills/15-multilingual-adaptation.md): Arabic (RTL), German, French, and Spanish resume & outreach localization.
- [Rejection Pattern Analyzer](skills/16-rejection-pattern-analyzer.md): Detect recurring skill gaps, ATS channel bottlenecks, and stale `>= 14d` outcomes.
- [Score Calibration](skills/17-score-calibration.md): Calibrate `1-10` match scores against actual interview callbacks.
- [Condition-Based Browser Waiting](skills/18-condition-based-browser-waiting.md): Replace fixed sleeps with snapshot readiness checks and semantic locators.
- [On-Demand MCP Routing](skills/19-on-demand-mcp-routing.md): Keep local JSON/Markdown tasks zero-MCP and load Playwright/Notion strictly by phase.
- [Skill Authoring Standard](skills/20-skill-authoring-standard.md): Contributor contract following `anthropics/skills`, `obra/superpowers`, and `agentskills.io`.
- [ATS Keyword Heatmap](skills/21-ats-keyword-heatmap.md): Deterministic Before vs. After ATS keyword match percentage verifier.
- [Technical Assessment Architect](skills/22-technical-assessment-architect.md): Take-home challenge blueprint, edge-case matrix, and code-review defense Q&A.
- [Contract & NDA Auditor](skills/23-contract-and-nda-auditor.md): Employment contract and B2B MSA/NDA clause auditor with polite redline drafts.
- [Circuit Breaker & Anti-Ban](skills/24-circuit-breaker-and-antiban.md): Immediate 24-hour platform cooldown on CAPTCHA, Cloudflare/DataDome, 429s, or forced login redirects.
- [Prompt-Injection Defense](skills/25-prompt-injection-defense.md): Treats scraped JDs as untrusted data, blocks honeypots/injections, and surfaces benign recruiter attention checks.
- [Deduplication & Blacklist Guard](skills/26-deduplication-and-blacklist-guard.md): Cross-channel `company::role_title` fingerprinting and employer/domain blacklists.
- [Universal CV Builder](skills/27-universal-cv-builder.md): Universal CV builder and persistent iterative revision SOP for any person or field (with third-party workspace isolation).
- [Recruiter, Personal Brand & Domain Intelligence](skills/28-recruiter-brand-and-domain-intelligence.md): Cross-cutting Senior HR JD decoder, 6-10s CV scan & truthful risk framing, LinkedIn Recruiter SEO, and dynamic multi-industry adapter.
- [Portfolio Builder & Multi-Host Deployer](skills/29-portfolio-builder-and-deployer.md): Isolated personalized portfolio website builder (`logs/portfolio/<slug>/`: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Astro, Vite+React, Next.js), pre-publish PII/secret scan, and `APPROVE`-gated CLI deployer (`/build-portfolio`).
- [Portfolio Design System Studio & QA](skills/30-portfolio-design-system-and-qa.md): Pre-code `DESIGN_PLAN.md` + separated `portfolio-data`, 7 curated WCAG-AA palettes + `Custom` hex derivation, RTL Arabic typography, `tokens.css` lock, 3-layer QA (`node --test`/isolated `vitest` + `375px`/`768px`/`1440px` -> `qa-report.md`), and bounded 3-cycle Self-Healing Loop (`/portfolio-design`).
- [LinkedIn Growth & Recruiter-SEO Optimizer](skills/linkedin-growth.md): Grounded `0-100` LinkedIn profile audit and section-by-section optimizer (`DRAFT_ONLY` + `APPROVE` gate).
- [Profile Intelligence Engine](skills/profile-intelligence-engine.md): Cross-platform Profile Intelligence Engine with schema-validated update plans, batch-fill, and fresh read-back verification.
- [B2B Contract Networks](skills/platforms/b2b-contract-networks.md): Playbook for Toptal, Braintrust, Lemon.io, Gun.io, Contra, Arc.dev, and Turing.

## Examples & Adapters

- [Sandbox Demo Mode](examples/sandbox-demo/expected-mission-control.md): Try `/demo` in 15 seconds with zero personal data.
- [Sample Interview Dossier](examples/outputs/sample-interview-dossier.md): Real generated prep packet example.
- [Sample 75-Word Outreach](examples/outputs/sample-outreach-75-words.md): Real anti-slop hiring-manager draft.
- [Sample Interrogation Transcript](examples/outputs/sample-interrogation-transcript.md): Readiness gate onboarding transcript.
- [MCP Bundle Examples](mcp/mcp.template.json): Portable Playwright + optional Notion MCP configuration.
- [Zero-Dependency CLI](bin/cli.mjs): Cross-platform installer & validator supporting `init`, `audit`, `proof`, `eval`, `pre-submit`, `doctor`, `status`, `dashboard`, `bundle`, `unlock`, `backup`, `login`, `sync-mcp`, and `update`.
- [Quick Tailoring Workflow](.agent/workflows/quick-tailor.md): Fast-start CV tailoring from 1 CV + 1 JD with human fact confirmation and zero browser login required.
